mechanism: RMSprop's first steps are lr/sqrt(small square-avg) ≈ up to 10× lr with no momentum smoothing; in unnormalized MLPs these kicks inflate hidden activations and the MSE output, so training oscillates. LayerNorm bounds hidden scale (and residual paths keep the function near-identity), absorbing the kicks — predicts instability only when the RMSprop net lacks LN/residual, as observed (6/6 vs 4/8).
